name: Twili Linux

description.en: A historical My Little Pony-related Linux distribution developed by Adrian Siekierka as an experimental Linux From Scratch project.

historicalNotes: The available records span approximately 2012–2013. The earliest and latest visible repository activity dates are July 10 and July 13, 2012. Siekierka retrospectively lists the project under 2013; that heading does not establish a later commit or a discontinuation date. The repository contains packaging and installation tooling. Its README describes installation through a chroot and lists non-kdrive X server support as unfinished. GitHub lists no official releases. The README’s chroot archive and installer URLs survive as historical references with unconfirmed availability.

events.title: Public source repository created
events.description: The repository dates to July 10. The earliest visible commit also dates to this day.

events.title: Last visible repository update

events.title: Year listed in the developer’s retrospective
events.description: Siekierka groups Twili Linux under 2013 in his project history and describes it as his first Linux From Scratch experiment. The year is a retrospective attribution, not a release date.
